depth.h2: What Hinsdale Homes Need From a Plumber
depth.intro: Hinsdale’s housing is a mix of eras on the same block. About 1 in 6 homes was built before 1940, and more than 4 in 10 went up after 1990, many of them where an older house used to stand. The median home here was built in 1981, but that number hides a wide range.

tiles.title: Historic Homes Around Robbins Park
tiles.body: The Robbins Park Historic District alone has 368 buildings on streets laid out in the 1860s and 1870s. Homes from that era often still have cast iron drains and clay sewer pipe, even after the kitchens and baths were redone. A [camera inspection](/hinsdale/video-camera-sewer-inspections) shows the condition of your line before you decide on a [sewer repair](/hinsdale/sewer-repair).

tiles.title: New Builds on Old Sewer Connections
tiles.body: When a new home replaces an older one, the line to the street isn’t always replaced with it. A brand-new house can end up connected to an old clay lateral. If you have slow drains or a backup in a newer home, a camera look at the full line is the fastest way to find out why.

tiles.title: Heavy Rain and Basement Backups
tiles.body: In June 2021, a storm sent sewer water bubbling more than 5 feet high near County Line Road and Walnut Street, and one homeowner nearby had about 3 feet of water in a basement that had never flooded before. A [sump pump with a battery backup](/hinsdale/sump-pumps) and a [backflow valve](/hinsdale/flood-control-maintenance) are the first lines of defense.

tiles.title: Protecting Finished Spaces From Hidden Leaks
tiles.body: In a home with plaster walls, custom tile and finished basements, a small leak can do a lot of damage before you see it. We [find the leak](/hinsdale/leak-repairs) and open as little as possible to fix it. If a pipe bursts in a winter freeze, we’re on call 24/7 for [burst pipe repair](/hinsdale/burst-pipe-repair).

items.q: How much does a plumber cost in Hinsdale?
items.a: It depends on the job. The main factors are what’s wrong, how hard it is to reach, the parts or materials needed and the age of your plumbing. Work behind plaster or custom tile can take more care than work in an open basement. We give you a flat-rate price before any work begins, so you know the cost going in.

items.a: Call us any time, day or night, including weekends and holidays. Our Spinning Wheel Road office keeps our plumbers close to Hinsdale, and we [treat emergencies as a priority](/hinsdale/emergency-plumbing). Arrival times depend on the day, but we’ll get a plumber to you as soon as we can.

items.q: My home is over 100 years old. What should I check?
items.preview: Start with the sewer line and the drains.
items.a: Start with the sewer line and the drains. Homes from that era often have clay sewer pipe and cast iron drains, and both wear out with age. A camera inspection shows the condition of your sewer line. Age alone doesn’t mean something is wrong, but an inspection lets you plan repairs instead of reacting to a backup.

items.q: We just built a new home. Do we still need a sewer inspection?
items.preview: It’s worth checking. If the builder reused the old line to the street, your new house may be connected to an older clay lateral.
items.a: It’s worth checking. If the builder reused the old line to the street, your new house may be connected to an older clay lateral. A camera inspection shows what’s there and whether it was replaced.

items.q: Can you do plumbing work without damaging plaster, tile or finished floors?
items.preview: We plan the work around them.
items.a: We plan the work around them. We locate the problem before we open anything, protect floors and finishes while we work and open as little as possible. When a sewer line needs work under a finished yard, [trenchless repair](/hinsdale/trenchless-sewer-repair) can often avoid digging up the landscaping.

items.q: When should I replace my water heater?
items.preview: Tank water heaters usually last somewhere around 8 to 12 years.
items.a: Tank water heaters usually last somewhere around 8 to 12 years. Rusty water, rumbling noises, a leak at the base or hot water that runs out faster than it used to all mean it’s time to have it checked. If you’re considering a [tankless water heater](/hinsdale/tankless-water-heater), we can tell you whether your gas line and venting are ready for one.
